# Governed repositories

The human-readable view of `governance/repos.json`, the manifest of repositories this organization governs. The table is generated by `tools/repos.mjs` and gated in CI; the schema, and the rules for onboarding, offboarding, and recording a variance, are in [manifest.md](manifest.md).
